# Retrieval evaluation (generated by `python -m scripts.eval_retrieval`)

Date: 2026-11-17 · embedder: `ollama` (`nomic-embed-text`) · tenant alpha, principal with groups support+oncall · 20 answerable and 10 unanswerable hand-labelled questions · `min_score` evaluated at 0.45.

Labels were written by the author of the code (not independent); n is small; one run.

| MRR | 1.000 |
| top-1 score | min 0.576 / median 0.770 / max 0.867 |
| rejected by `min_score` 0.45 | 0/20 |

## Unanswerable questions (beta-only or off-topic)

| metric | value |
|---|---|
| top-1 score | min 0.428 / median 0.529 / max 0.676 |
| still accepted by `min_score` 0.45 (the LLM must abstain) | 8/10 |

The score ranges of the two groups overlap whenever the unanswerable max is above the answerable min (here 0.676 vs 0.576); the threshold then cannot separate them and the model's abstention covers the rest.
